ine_app_nombres.name: INE, Frecuencia de nombres (consulta)
ine_app_nombres.contains: names: count and per mil by province, municipality, decade of birth and province, nationality; national mean age
ine_app_nombres.coverage: Spain; census 1-1-2025; >=20 in Spain and >=5 in the area
ine_app_nombres.access: web form, one query per area (blank name = full list, capped at 5 000 rows)
ine_app_nombres.licence_evidence: INE aviso legal: reuse allowed citing the source

ine_app_apellidos.name: INE, Frecuencia de apellidos (consulta)
ine_app_apellidos.contains: surnames: first, second and both, count and per mil, by province and municipality of residence or birth, nationality
ine_app_apellidos.coverage: Spain; census 1-1-2025; >5 in Spain and >=5 in the area
ine_app_apellidos.access: web form, one query per area (blank = full list, capped at 5 000 rows)
ine_app_apellidos.licence_evidence: INE aviso legal: reuse allowed citing the source

ine_nomnac.name: INE, Nombres de los recién nacidos (Estadística de nacimientos, Registro Civil)
ine_nomnac.contains: top 100 names of the newborns per year in Spain and top 10 per comunidad autónoma, by sex

ine_padron_excel.name: INE, Apellidos y nombres más frecuentes (Excel)
ine_padron_excel.contains: national lists (names >=20, top 50 by decade of birth and province), surnames

gentilicios_base.name: Gentilicios de España (proyecto hermano): lista de municipios y polígonos
gentilicios_base.contains: INE municipality list joined to GISCO LAU 2024 and Wikidata by INE code; simplified polygons
gentilicios_base.licence: GISCO: © EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries

eswiktionary.name: Wikcionario en español: entradas de antropónimos (ES:Antropónimos masculinos, femeninos) y apellidos (ES:Apellidos), sección Español: Etimología, acepciones, Traducciones
eswiktionary.authority: crowd; etymologies often without a cited reference, some cite Hakim 1988 or Faure

eswiki.name: Wikipedia en español: artículos de nombre propio y de apellido (Ficha de nombre propio, Ficha de apellido; secciones Etimología, Origen, Significado; frase inicial)
eswiki.authority: crowd; some articles cite onomastic dictionaries (Faure, Albaigès, Tibón) and philologists

wikidata.name: Wikidata: items of class given name (Q202444 and subclasses, male Q12308941, female Q11879590, unisex Q3409032) and family name (Q101352 and subclasses): labels, description, P407, P460
wikidata.authority: crowd; name items are mostly bulk-created and rarely referenced

rule_patronymic.name: Deduction of ours: surname ending in -EZ/-AZ/-IZ/-OZ whose stem is a given name in the INE lists (scripts/build_claims_etymology.py, claims_rule_patronymic)
rule_patronymic.authority: none: a deduction from the shape of the word; every row is proposed

ieca_nomape.name: IECA, Estadística de nombres y apellidos de los andaluces
ieca_nomape.contains: top 50 names per sex and top 50 first, second and either-position surnames, per mil only (no counts), for Andalucía, each province and each municipality (INE codes); top 10 names per sex with counts by year of birth 1925-2025 (Andalucía only); search of one name with counts per municipality; lists per country of nationality
ieca_nomape.coverage: Andalucía; only the current reference date is online (1-1-2026); the site updates once a year since 1-1-2010 and overwrites the previous edition; fewer than 5 people not shown
ieca_nomape.access: JSF (Apache Trinidad) web forms, POST with a server-side view state, one query per area (bd/nomApeBD/faces/frecuentes.xhtml); no file, no API
ieca_nomape.licence_evidence: IECA aviso legal §2 (https://www.juntadeandalucia.es/institutodeestadisticaycartografia/dega/aviso-legal): CC BY 4.0 for the statistics of the Sistema Estadístico y Cartográfico de Andalucía unless stated otherwise
ieca_nomape.shares_origin_with: ine_padron: built from the Registro de Población de Andalucía, which IECA keeps from the municipal padrones sent by the INE, so it is not independent of ine_app_nombres / ine_app_apellidos

ieca_nomnac.name: IECA, Estadística de nombres de los recién nacidos andaluces
ieca_nomnac.contains: newborn names: top 100 per sex with counts for Andalucía and each province 1996-2025; most frequent name per sex per municipality with count 2010-2025 (all tied names); map layer (XML) of the most frequent name per municipality, no counts
ieca_nomnac.coverage: Andalucía; births 1996-2025 (municipalities 2010-2025); fewer than 5 not shown; last update 3-7-2026
ieca_nomnac.access: JSP pages, plain GET, one query per area and year (bd/nombresBD/tablaFrecuentes.jsp, frecuentesMunicipios.jsp); no file, no API
ieca_nomnac.shares_origin_with: ine_nomnac: both come from the births of the Movimiento Natural de la Población (INE with the Registro Civil), so they are not independent

pegv_estnom_top.name: IVE, Estadística de los nombres y los apellidos de la población de la Comunitat Valenciana: los más frecuentes según territorio
pegv_estnom_top.contains: top 30 women's names, men's names and surnames per territory (Comunitat, 3 provinces, 542 municipalities), count and per mil; surnames counted as 1st or 2nd surname
pegv_estnom_top.coverage: Comunitat Valenciana; padrón at 1 January 2011-2022; names with >=15 in the Comunitat and >=5 in the area
pegv_estnom_top.access: web form, one query per year, variable and territory (res_top.php, 30 rows at most); 19 656 pages
pegv_estnom_top.licence: public institution; no open licence declared
pegv_estnom_top.licence_evidence: pegv.gva.es/avis-legal (checked 2026-09-19): site made under Decret 81/2014 art. 39.4 to give access to official statistics; commercialising that access is forbidden; no reuse licence stated

pegv_estnom_name.name: IVE, Estadística de los nombres y los apellidos: según territorio (one name, every municipality)
pegv_estnom_name.contains: one exact name or surname per query, every municipality at once, count and per mil; also by age and nationality (names) or by 1st/2nd/either surname and nationality
pegv_estnom_name.access: web form, one query per name, year and variable (res_optimo.php); blank or wildcard name refused; NOT downloaded (about 10 000 names per year)
pegv_estnom_name.licence: public institution; no open licence declared

ibestat_nounats.name: IBESTAT, Noms dels nounats (Estadística de naixements)
ibestat_nounats.contains: per year and sex, table x.08 'Distribución municipal de los nombres (frecuencia >4)': every name with more than 4 newborns in the Balearic Islands, with its count in the Islands, each island and each of the 67 municipalities (1 and 2 included); also top lists per island (x.01-x.05), name of child vs parent (x.06) and top names per municipality (x.07, xls), not read
ibestat_nounats.coverage: Illes Balears; births 2005-2024; threshold > 4 in the whole Islands, none below
ibestat_nounats.access: PC-Axis file per table (also CSV, JSON-stat, JSON at /ibestat/service/ibestat/pxcontent/..., seen in the page code, not tested), bulk
ibestat_nounats.licence: reuse allowed citing the source; each PX file says CC BY 3.0
ibestat_nounats.licence_evidence: IBESTAT avís legal §3 (https://ibestat.es/avis-legal/): reuse allowed citing 'Font: IBESTAT', without altering the content, stating the date of last update. PX field SOURCE: 'Institut d'Estadística de les Illes Balears (IBESTAT). España (CC BY 3.0)'

idescat_nadons.name: Idescat, Noms dels nadons (estadística de naixements)
idescat_nadons.contains: per year, area and sex, the full list of names with frequency >= 4 in that area, with rank (Pos.), count and per mil of births of that sex; spelling variants counted as one name are written together (JÚLIA/JULIA)
idescat_nadons.coverage: Catalunya, 4 provinces, 8 àmbits (not read), 43 comarcas (current list, Moianès from 2015, Lluçanès from 2023); births 1997-2025; threshold >= 4 in the area
idescat_nadons.access: web download f=ssv, one file per area, year and sex (the API api.idescat.cat/onomastica/v1/nadons gives the same list 25 per page, without accents)
idescat_nadons.licence: reuse allowed citing the source; API use under Idescat API conditions
idescat_nadons.licence_evidence: Idescat aviso legal (https://www.idescat.cat/institut/web/): reuse allowed citing 'Fuente: Idescat', without altering the content, stating the date of last update. API conditions (https://www.idescat.cat/dev/api/): acknowledge the origin with links, do not modify the data, limit repeated requests. No CC BY 4.0 statement found on these pages (not verified elsewhere)

idescat_codis.name: Idescat, Codis territorials: municipis
idescat_codis.contains: the 947 municipalities of Catalonia with their 6-digit code (INE 5 digits + INE check digit) and comarca code and name
idescat_codis.coverage: current list on the retrieval date
